correctness.rationale: The generator identities reconstruct exactly: \(L(xy-z)=x^2-4y^2\), \(Lz=xz+3y^2\), and the stated \(L(yz)\) rigidity identity. They yield the energy ratio, anticorrelation and sign consequences for compact invariant measures. The reverser \(R(x,y,z)=(-x,y,-z)\) satisfies \(f(Ru)=-Rf(u)\), so R-invariant measures have zero x and z means. For an R-invariant periodic orbit, \(y=-\dot x\) and the energy law give \(\int x^2=4\int\dot x^2\); zero mean plus Wirtinger gives \(P\ge4\pi\). Equality forces a first harmonic. Eliminating y,z gives \(x'''-xx''+x'-x^2+3(x')^2=0\); the equality substitution and one-period integration force \(\dot x\equiv0\), contradicting nonconstancy. Hence the bound is strict.
